What picture is missing from the multiplication model below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130082/assets/39c8668bd4bf5309b708769a99d9d3fa2184f0937411d437de8a1195853e5118.png)
question.worked_solution:
In the model, we have $\dfrac{1}{4}$ on the left.

Since we are multiplying by $\dfrac{1}{\color{blue}5}$, we need to split the whole into $\color{blue}5$ equal parts horizontally.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130082/assets/6584c694fbbc990dfa3b58a19545d3deb9889f162da6e02a9820310a190ae04e.png)

From the picture on the right, we obtain that the shaded part represents $\dfrac{1}{20}$ of the whole.

The missing picture is:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130082/assets/e349233ebb5e3927f0d4bda98cb2470c1f17574a522d2f4b9cbddaf365fe946d.png)
